frame.label: bounded observation frame
frame.labSelection: latest numeric record per declared item at or before cutoff and within lookback
frame.prescriptionSelection: records whose declared start/stop interval overlaps cutoff
frame.prescriptionSemantics: prescription record only; not medication administration or adherence

similarity.missingnessRule: a pair missing any declared frame lab is ineligible

historicalLoad.reason: No finite clinically meaningful path space, cost function, or history-free baseline is declared; undefined must not be displayed as zero.

nonClaims: A diagnosis code would remain a recorded code, not a confirmed diagnosis.
A prescription record is not a medication administration record.
Missing laboratory data is not normal laboratory data.
Similar bounded frames do not establish patient identity or clinical equivalence.
Shifted dates are not real calendar dates.
The five-subject cohort is not representative of a clinical population.
The source projection is not mutated by analysis.
